{{Top|leg}}
A '''galven ring''' was a component used in [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weaponry. The component helped the weapon maintain a cohesive blaster bolt during the firing process. [[Defender sporting blaster pistol/Legends|Defender sporting blaster pistols]] had a galven ring installed inside the weapon's [[final stage collimator barrel]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
